diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.158), which favours a robust combination.
